title: Sociocultural Considerations in Monitoring Anti-LGBTQ+ Content on Social Media
reasoning: The paper includes a component that evaluates the influence of religious subtext and puritanical moral frameworks on hate speech detection. It specifically analyzes word-tokens like 'bible', 'god', and 'Adam' in the model's predicted outputs, linking them to religious beliefs and puritanical morality that inform anti-LGBTQ+ sentiment.
